scope: Target-owned WebTransport browser media peer revision after original independently muted preparation. Isolated SDK unit behavior only; no new live handoff qualification.
finding: The negotiated native binding begins at revision1, but the original target-owned preparation receipt confirms its gate at revision2. Retain that exact confirmed revision so a subsequent explicit typed control can reach current server admission.
behavior: Only an original connection.offer with the captured handoff-preparation marker can apply this special revision update. The completed receipt must confirm stream_revision2, the exact preparation profile and prepared_muted=true, while the installed binding remains revision1.

Wrong revision, false mute confirmation or missing preparation metadata produces a protocol failure and closes the original peer. The original offer marker is captured before asynchronous codec support; mutation of the caller input cannot change it.
